properties.decision:
Anthony, 2026-09-14, on the field report of four hand-rolled analyses: "I'd like to fix this for all 4." That is the ruling on the question a consumer's agent refused to guess at — "reflow2 reads the design graph, not source trees, and whether it should is a real question."

THE RULING: yes, for the class. A question the DESIGN holds open whose EVIDENCE lives in SOURCE — does my declared decomposition match the real coupling; where is code duplicated; which protocols does the system actually speak at its boundaries; which build or deployment profiles exist — is served by reflow2 as an analysis over the artifacts the design has registered.

THE THREE CONDITIONS THAT COME WITH IT, all already stated on the one instrument that existed (cap:a-declared-wall-is-checked-against-the-coupling-it-contains):
  1. NO CONFIGURATION — the file set comes from Artifact locations and REALIZES, never from a path somebody points at. A user gets the analysis the moment they have registered artifacts.
  2. IT NEVER QUIETLY GUESSES — files in a language it cannot read, files the design names and disk lacks, are COUNTED AND NAMED, never scored zero.
  3. IT REPORTS AND NEVER WRITES. An import graph is coupling, not a contract; a clone is similarity, not a duplicate; a protocol string is a token, not a published boundary. These answer "does what I declared hold" and are never written back as CONSUMES, DUPLICATES or an Interface — the mechanical-scan lesson of fact:adopt-ran-on-reflow2-and-the-mechanical-contract-recovery-collapsed (91 proposed against a real 17).

AND THE DELIVERY CONDITION THE ROOT CAUSE ADDED: an analysis exists for a consumer only when it is SERVED (find_tools can return it), NAMED (a skill points at it), and GATED (a check notices a capability that claims reach it does not have). A script in this checkout is none of those.

ORDER: the wall check first — it exists and was hand-rewritten once already. The other three need their questions defined in the user's terms before they are built (what counts as a clone, a protocol, a profile), which is exactly the guess the consumer's agent declined to make.
properties.name: DECIDED — reflow2 reads source trees as well as the design: the questions a design holds open whose evidence lives in source are served as analyses that REPORT and never write back as design
properties.rationale: Recorded as accepted on the owner's word rather than left as an idea, because the sentence "fix this for all 4" settles the yes/no and the four named analyses make the scope concrete. The conditions are not new — they are the wall check's own stated limits, promoted from one instrument's prose to the rule every instrument of this kind inherits. Recorded separately from dec:idea-can-reflow2-see-the-work-a-session-did-by-hand, which is about SEEING hand-rolled work; this is about ANSWERING the questions it was rolled for.
